purpose: Decision checklist to be used only after the complete 1W/4W/12W forward OOS cycle is available. This file does not change the model, thresholds, weights, runtime, pair logic, or OOS baseline.

review_order.name: Integrity first
questions: Was the frozen runtime untouched throughout the OOS window?
Did fingerprint 3356baf0 remain unchanged?
Were all checkpoint prices evaluated with the canonical ECB fixing rule?
Were any pair labels, thresholds, weights, or anchors changed after T0?
review_order.stop_rule: If any integrity condition fails, do not interpret performance. Mark the affected OOS segment invalid and identify the contamination point.

review_order.name: Horizon decomposition
questions: How did directional pair performance differ at 1W, 4W, and 12W?
Was any apparent edge concentrated only at one horizon?
Did medium-horizon behaviour confirm or reject the prior pseudo-OOS suggestion that signal quality may be better beyond 1W?
review_order.rule: Do not promote a rule change from a single horizon alone.

review_order.name: Signal quality decomposition
questions: Did strong structural contrasts outperform partial/relative advantages?
Did price confirmation improve outcomes relative to price divergence?
Did Macro + Rates/CB convergence outperform mixed states?
Were losses concentrated in specific currencies, pair families, or regime types?

review_order.name: Turning hierarchy review
questions: Did single turning-point states behave as early warnings rather than immediate directional signals?
Did persistent turning states show higher confirmation value than single turning states?
Did actual Macro direction changes remain more reliable than turning states?
candidate_changes_only_if_supported: display hierarchy for first signal / possible change / confirmed structural change
prohibited_without_forward_support: changing turning thresholds because CAD/EUR historical revision studies looked attractive
turning-to-trading conversion based only on PIT retrospective research

review_order.name: Macro block robustness
questions: Did Growth and Labour agreement matter for forward outcomes?
Were mixed Growth/Labour states lower-conviction in live forward behaviour?
Did Growth-dominant vulnerability observed in CAD/EUR revision studies translate into worse forward outcomes?
candidate_research: confidence modifier for internal Growth divergence
confidence modifier for Labour divergence only if forward evidence supports it
review_order.note: Historical revision sensitivity is diagnostic context, not sufficient evidence for a runtime change.

review_order.name: Rates and policy hierarchy
questions: Did front-end / 2Y repricing add directional information when consistent with Macro?
Did long-end-led moves behave differently from front-end-led moves?
Were any poor outcomes caused by treating 10Y strength as currency support when the move was term-premium/fiscal/supply-driven?
Did explicit OIS availability improve interpretation where active?
candidate_changes_only_if_supported: confidence treatment for front-end vs long-end disagreement
clearer policy-family confidence rules when OIS is WITHHELD

review_order.name: Positioning, liquidity, and price overlays
questions: Did COT confirmation improve outcomes or mainly provide context?
Did crowded positioning reduce continuation quality?
Did liquidity overlays improve discrimination?
Did price divergence consistently identify fragile signals or simply create false negatives?
review_order.rule: Do not increase overlay weights unless forward evidence shows stable incremental value.

review_order.name: Pair construction review
questions: Did forced relative ranking create errors where both currencies were mixed?
Did the no-forced-winner rule protect against bad pair calls?
Which pair archetypes produced the cleanest forward outcomes?
Were outcomes dominated by USD legs, commodity FX, funding currencies, or a small subset of crosses?

review_order.name: Decision gate
review_order.rule_change_requirement: Any change to thresholds, weights, turning logic, pair hierarchy, runtime classification, or decision semantics requires a new frozen baseline and a fresh OOS cycle.

prefer: agreement between forward outcomes and PIT diagnostics
clear falsifiable mechanism rather than post-hoc story

post_review_outputs: decision on whether to change model
if changed: exact specification, rationale, new fingerprint, new T0, and OOS restart date
